name: Italy
centre: VFS Global: London, plus Manchester and Edinburgh satellites (+2 working days)
form_type: harmonised form (paper or centre online form, per country; needs verification)

journey.step: Check visa type and documents on the official MFA portal
Check the Italian Consulate London instructions
Fill in and sign the harmonised Schengen application form
Book a VFS Global Italy UK appointment (London, or the Manchester/Edinburgh satellites) and pay the £13.16 service fee

base: Passport (issued <10 yrs, valid 3+ months after return, 2 blank pages)
UK residence proof (eVisa share code / BRP) valid 3+ months after return

SkilledWorker: Employer letter confirming job, salary and approved leave
Student: Sponsor letter and sponsor bank statements if funded by family
Spouse: Partner's passport/ID and, if they fund the trip, their bank statements
other: Proof of current UK status valid 3+ months beyond return — check eligibility first

processing: base time needs verification; +2 working days at satellites
portal_label: Il Visto per l'Italia (official MFA portal)
